component.name: Kinefin
component.summary: A KDE Plasma 6 Jellyfin client with native mpv playback

description.p: Kinefin is a client for Jellyfin servers, written for Plasma. Browse your library natively in Kirigami and play through native libmpv: audio passthrough, hardware decoding, subtitle styling, and the display refresh rate following your media on Plasma Wayland.

It is a native app, not a web wrapper: the interface is Plasma's, the Jellyfin client talks to the server API directly, and there is no browser embedded. Server administration stays where it belongs — one button opens the server's web interface in your browser.

ul.li: In-app download manager with series auto-rules (next unwatched episodes, whole seasons, new episodes), exportable to your own folders through the portals
Downloaded titles play fully offline in the same interface
Direct play with hardware decoding, or transcodes only when the settings ask for it
Audio passthrough per codec (AC3, E-AC3, DTS, DTS-HD, TrueHD), device selection, normalization
Subtitles of your server, with native styling and per-language selection
MPRIS on the session bus, screensaver inhibition, gamepads through SDL3

description.p: Part of the world, not of the web:

ul.li: Follows your Plasma theme, translations, keyboard shortcuts and HIG patterns
Single instance, sessions per profile like Jellyfin Desktop
